recommendations.title: Create an interactive battery payback calculator
recommendations.details: Build an on-site interactive calculator that asks for: annual household electricity consumption (kWh), typical self-consumption share or expected solar production (kWh), local elområde or municipal average prices, current grid/effektavgift inputs, intended battery usable capacity (kWh) and expected revenue from aggregator/stödtjänster. Output should show: installed cost before/after grönt avdrag, annual savings (lower purchased electricity + avoided effect/peak charges + aggregator revenue), a year-by-year cashflow, simple payback (years) and an ROI table under three scenarios (conservative/expected/optimistic). Include explanatory tooltips and a button to request a personalized offer.

For each example state all assumptions (elpris, own production kWh, grid/effektavgift, aggregator income, battery degradation, region/elområde). Show both gross and net cost after grönt avdrag and present simple payback + sensitivity ranges.
